project_name: AuraControl - Ultimea A40 Soundbar Remote & BLE Explorer
design_philosophy: A dual-identity app. The main controller screens (Remote, EQ) must feel like an expensive, tactile piece of high-end audio equipment (deep blacks, subtle metallic elevations, crisp geometric typography). The BLE Explorer screens must feel like a precision developer tool (dense, high-contrast, terminal-inspired monospaced typography).

layout_strategy.remote_screen: Centralized, hero-focused layout. The volume dial is the dominant centerpiece, taking up 50% of vertical space, perfectly centered. Bottom half holds secondary controls in a symmetrical grid.
layout_strategy.eq_screen: Dense, functional layout. Vertical sliders taking up majority of the screen with clear value labels above them.
layout_strategy.explorer_screen: List-heavy, edge-to-edge terminal layout. Minimal padding for logs to maximize data density.

VolumeDial.style: Large circular element. Outer ring: svg dashed circle (stroke-dasharray) for volume markers. Inner circle: bg-[#121215] with subtle inner shadow to mimic physical depth. Large H1 text in the absolute center.
VolumeDial.interaction: Pan gesture up/down or circular rotation (if using react-native-gesture-handler).
VolumeDial.tailwind_classes: w-64 h-64 rounded-full bg-[#121215] border border-[#1F1F24] shadow-[0_10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5),inset_0_2px_10px_rgba(255,255,255,0.03)] flex items-center justify-center relative

SoundModeChip.style: Minimalist rectangular or pill-shaped cards. Inactive: flat dark grey. Active: white border with crisp white text.
SoundModeChip.tailwind_classes_inactive: bg-[#1C1C21] border border-transparent rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-w-[100px]
SoundModeChip.tailwind_classes_active: bg-[#1C1C21] border border-white rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-w-[100px] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)]

EQSlider.style: Tall vertical slider. Track is very thin (e.g., 4px width). Thumb is a crisp white rectangle or pill.

TerminalLogView.style: Pure black background, zero corner radius, monospaced text. No shadows.
TerminalLogView.tailwind_classes: bg-[#050505] w-full flex-1 p-4 font-mono overflow-y-auto

BottomTabBar.style: Floating or frosted glass effect at the bottom.
BottomTabBar.tailwind_classes: absolute bottom-0 w-full h-20 bg-[#0A0A0C]/85 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#1F1F24] flex flex-row items-center justify-around pb-safe

icons.library: lucide-react-native (if React Native) or lucide-react (if Web)
icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a premium, lightweight feel. Never use filled icons unless indicating an active tab state.

images.description: Subtle dark metallic scratch texture to be used with very low opacity (5-10%) as a background layer overlay to give the app a hardware feel.

motion.transitions: Use react-native-reanimated for smooth layout transitions. 200ms ease-out for button presses (scale down to 0.95).
motion.haptics: CRITICAL: Since this mimics hardware, integrate exact haptic feedback (ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light) on every volume tick, EQ slider move, and chip selection.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. FRAMEWORK: Build using Expo & React Native. Use NativeWind for Tailwind styling. If the environment restricts to pure React JS web, build a mobile-first web app mimicking a native app (PWA style).
2. FONTS: Import Manrope and JetBrains Mono from Expo-Google-Fonts.
3. TESTING: Ensure EVERY interactive element has a 'data-testid' (if web) or 'testID' (if React Native) following kebab-case naming (e.g., testID='volume-dial', testID='mode-movie-chip').
4. ICONS: Use Lucide icons. Ensure they are crisp and well-aligned.

5. BLE LOGIC: For the BLE Explorer, mock the BleManager connection logic and GATT discovery if real hardware isn't available, but build the UI to accurately represent a real device scan (UUIDs, Services, Characteristics, Hex strings).
6. LANGUAGE: All UI text must be in FRENCH as requested by the user.
